protocol.container: All methods v4 fixed blocks; no format change
protocol.ordering: One full warmup/config, then shuffled condition/round jobs; encode followed by fresh-process restore. All range jobs shuffled separately.
protocol.transforms: Explicit 4-byte grids over entire original files, including headers and markers; not semantic type routing
protocol.selection: Ordinary codec first, then selected transform+same codec; use only if payload gain exceeds local label cost. Full metadata cost reported; policy may still lose overall.
protocol.integrity: Unchanged bounded decompression, manifest/block/file SHA and external bytewise restore/range truth; deterministic archives each round.
protocol.persistence: Both encode and restore request file flush/fsync; restore files explicitly selected; no directory/volume or power-loss guarantee. Windows publication retries included in phase timing.
protocol.ranges: Same original byte requests per round across every configuration/mode. 64KiB-grid cross_chunk windows may not cross a 1MiB block.
protocol.cache: Full archive pre-read; warm OS cache; no decoded-block cache; fresh process per phase/range trial.
protocol.cost: Complete archive plus entire numeric.py allocated once; common runtime/core/codecs incomplete; no new native/model/dictionary dependency.
protocol.rss: Fresh phase processes; range includes truth and metadata ledger, not production RSS
protocol.journal: Append-only UTF-8 phase/range records flushed/fsynced outside timed workers; failures abort, no whole-job automatic retry, no overwrite of evidence.
protocol.acceptance: Four same-codec/block working points: allocated bytes<=ordinary; decode/resident/reopen paired median speedup>=1, each >=4/5 faster; encoding separately disclosed. See docs/CROSSDOMAIN.md.

limits: one SAC geophysics and one DCD molecular example; complete distributed test files, not entire scientific databases
DCD header declares 500 frames but contains 98 complete stored frames; original discrepancy retained
Python/LaTeX are byte-grid negative/guard controls, not code/math semantic encoders or correctness-of-program proofs
manual word widths, not an automatically learned router; no tuning using new compression results
single Windows host, warm OS cache; no cold/cross-machine/inference/Rust-numeric/CAS+numeric claim
historical close-only restores cannot be directly compared with current file-synced timings
